description: A finished Claude turn printed a CLI login URL as an OSC 8 hyperlink that the terminal wrapped across four rows; the capture materializes each row as [fragment](full-url). The same turn ends with a prose numbered list of options, under the user's own question and above their draft reply. Asserted: the parse's links carry the WHOLE auth URL, never a wrapped fragment, beside the mock link, even though this parse fails. The parser reads the user's own turn as a pending question and the retry paraphrases it, so grounding rejects both and the parse is left unread (activity unknown, parse_ok false, no headline): that is today's honest outcome, pinned so a change to it is noticed. The watcher keeps the previous card on such a failure, and used to drop these links with it, so the login link never reached the card; it now publishes a failed parse's links. Real screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-10), every name, path, URL and state/challenge value made fictional.
